name: Rosa Cygnus
source:
When Odilia was 11 years old, she cut out her own heart.
Eleven years later, she returns to where she left it behind, and begins to discover what consequences she's left in her wake.

[From [url=https://thlassicalamity.itch.io/swanrose]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
奥蒂莉亚在11岁那年，亲手剜出了自己的心脏。
十一年后，她重返当年遗落心脏的故地，开始一步步发掘自己当年留下的种种因果与余波。

[摘自[url=https://thlassicalamity.itch.io/swanrose]itch.io[/url]]
